name: WTSP Tree Traversal and Parallel Rendering
definition: The process of traversing the WTSP tree at run time to reconstruct and render data blocks of different spatio-temporal resolutions in parallel to compose the final image.
summary: WTSP Tree Traversal and Parallel Rendering efficiently visualizes large time-varying data on parallel clusters by eliminating parent-child dependencies and balancing workload via error-guided tree partitioning.
